title: Rate limit a login endpoint
brief: Attackers are trying thousands of passwords against `POST /login`. Add rate limiting without locking out the legitimate user who mistypes twice.
deliverables: What you count and by which key (IP address, account, both) and why
The algorithm (fixed window, sliding window or token bucket) and its numbers
The response when the limit is hit, including the headers a client can use
How a shared store keeps the count right across several servers
How you avoid letting an attacker lock a victim out on purpose
